name: Extended-reach and multilateral wells
applications: reaching offshore reservoirs from shore or one platform
principle: Extended-reach drilling (ERD) reaches a large reservoir area from one surface location by drilling very long deviated wells; multilateral wells add branches from a main bore. The record ERD well (Orlan platform, Sakhalin-1, 24 April 2015) has a measured depth of 13,500 m and a horizontal displacement of 12,030 m.
